coupling: The sample-width maintenance commit checks only colour storage for monochrome compositing, while its existing exact-depth check still protects the alpha plane. The later luma-only compositing commit accepts an independent alpha bit depth and relies on that earlier width check to select a Pixel type. Together, a 16-bit Y plane and 8-bit alpha plane reach the luma loop, which reads alpha through uint16_t and crosses its allocation. Either change in isolation retains the other guard; a correct repair must account for both the planning width invariant and the luma path’s independent alpha depth.
